column1: # OTA layout for the 4 MB flash on every board this fleet runs (docs/OTA.md).
# otadata picks the slot; ota_0/ota_1 are the A/B app slots (SLOT_SIZE in
# supervictor-common::firmware must equal their size). No factory slot: a
# USB flash writes ota_0 and an erased otadata boots it. Pass this file to
# espflash (-T): the runner in .cargo/config.toml and scripts/flash.sh do.
